### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 8 northern epilepsy variant  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.788)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:2079)

**Proposed mechanism:** CLN8 (HGNC:2079) —DISRUPTS→ Endoplasmic reticulum-associated degradation (ERAD) pathway (GO:0030433); Endoplasmic reticulum-associated degradation (ERAD) pathway (GO:0030433) —LEADS_TO→ Lysosomal protein trafficking and degradation (GO:0007039); Lysosomal protein trafficking and degradation (GO:0007039) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250); CLN8 (HGNC:2079) —DISRUPTS→ Lysosomal protein trafficking and degradation (GO:0007039); Lysosomal protein trafficking and degradation (GO:0007039) —LEADS_TO→ Epilepsy (HP:0001250). Loss-of-function mutations in CLN8 disrupt the ERAD pathway, leading to accumulation of misfolded proteins and subsequent disruption of lysosomal protein trafficking and degradation. This aberrant lysosomal function contributes to the development of seizures and epilepsy, common phenotypes in both diseases.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic variant in CLN8 with a high allele frequency (>5%) in gnomAD, or demonstration that CLN8 mutations do not impact ERAD or lysosomal trafficking in cellular models. _(variant: HGNC:2079)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of CLN8 in ERAD and lysosomal function could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting protein clearance or lysosomal dysfunction for both diseases.
